purpose: Define the complete single-dimension explorer behavior for each XPD-01..XPD-38 without introducing scientific cross-dimension comparisons, duplicate scientific ownership, or production UI implementation.
core_rule: Every explorer is a projection of exactly one governed Task-6.1 principal dimension. Status/provenance controls may clarify interpretation, but scientific filtering or comparison against another principal dimension is deferred to Task 6.4 and later.

explorer_archetypes.temporal: ordered time-bin exploration with date-type separation
explorer_archetypes.categorical: ranked category distribution plus record table
explorer_archetypes.scoped_categorical: category distribution with explicit source/scope lanes
explorer_archetypes.geographic: map or region view with accessible ranked table and declared association unit
explorer_archetypes.entity: resolved entity distribution with collision-safe identity
explorer_archetypes.network: node/edge view with declared graph unit and accessible edge/node tables
explorer_archetypes.hierarchical: taxonomy tree plus assignment counts without lexical hierarchy inference
explorer_archetypes.structured: facet-preserving structured records without flattening owner semantics
explorer_archetypes.taxonomy_lifecycle: taxonomy/classification explorer with lifecycle, alias and collision states
explorer_archetypes.composite_owner_preserving: child-dimension selector; one owner-preserving child explorer active at a time
explorer_archetypes.paired_state: paired but semantically distinct states from the same principal dimension
explorer_archetypes.repeatable_statement: repeatable evidence-backed statement records with independent recurrence kept separate
explorer_archetypes.metric_identity: metric identity/definition registry and occurrence view
explorer_archetypes.result_observation: context-rich observation table; pooling disabled unless compatibility is explicitly established
explorer_archetypes.typed_pathway: typed pathway components/relations with declared counting unit
explorer_archetypes.typed_relation: directed typed relation explorer with source/target/evidence drilldown
explorer_archetypes.curated_l7: read-only exploration of governed Level-7 curated objects

explorers.label: Temporal context
required_warnings: date types must remain separate
publication year is not extraction/verification date

explorers.label: Geographic provenance
required_warnings: association count is not paper count
affiliation geography is not application location or nationality

explorers.label: Collaboration context
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible collaboration edges with explicit node/edge unit
required_warnings: edge count is not paper count
network centrality is not scientific quality

explorers.label: Application evidence role / scope
required_warnings: demonstrated, related, potential and review-scoped roles never merge

explorers.label: Governing equation / equation family
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible equation items / problem records / papers

explorers.label: PINN type / family
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible verified/scoped type assignments / unique papers
required_warnings: raw occurrence is not normalized assignment
collisions and source-local meanings remain visible

explorers.label: Methodology
required_warnings: no pooled methodology frequency
each child owner retains its own denominator
no generic learning_type
PINN type, architecture, network configuration, learning paradigm and training protocol remain distinct

explorers.label: Claim vs demonstration
required_warnings: claim is not demonstration
absence of demonstration is not automatically a negative result

explorers.label: Reported advantage / disadvantage / failure
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible scoped statement records / unique papers

explorers.label: Validation strategy
explorers.denominator_basis: applicable eligible validation records / unique papers

explorers.label: Evaluation metric
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible metric occurrences / unique papers / test cases
required_warnings: same metric label may have different definitions
metric count is not paper count
incompatible definitions/scales must not be pooled

explorers.label: Evaluation result / test case
required_warnings: no naive averaging across heterogeneous metrics/scales/test cases
lower is not better unless metric direction is defined

explorers.label: Reproducibility reporting / computational context
explorers.denominator_basis: applicable paper reproducibility records per attribute

explorers.label: Limitation
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible limitation records / unique papers / independent study families
secondary_measures: independent study families/PEUs only when recurrence is claimed
required_warnings: repeated mentions within one paper are not independent recurrence
limitation is not open problem, future work or Atlas gap

explorers.label: Open problem
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible open-problem records / unique papers / independent study families
secondary_measures: independent study families/PEUs only when recurrence is claimed
required_warnings: author-stated and Atlas-inferred remain distinct
open problem is not official Atlas gap

explorers.label: Future work
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible future-work records / unique papers / independent study families
secondary_measures: independent study families/PEUs only when recurrence is claimed
required_warnings: future work is not current contribution or demonstration
future work is not automatically an Atlas opportunity

explorers.label: Failure / diagnostic pathway
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible pathways/components/typed edges with declared unit
required_warnings: unit must be declared
symptom is not diagnosis
intervention is not verified improvement
paper diagnostic pathway is not L7 failure framework

explorers.label: Evidence provenance / source role
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible evidence objects / linked unique papers
required_warnings: evidence count is not independent support
locator presence is not evidence strength

explorers.label: Evidence verification / support / strength
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible evidence objects per selected state facet
explorers.primary_measure: evidence objects for selected state facet
required_warnings: verification status is not support status
statement strength is not evidence count
verified is not automatically supportive

explorers.label: Contradiction / mismatch / ambiguity
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible conflict/evidence units / affected unique papers
required_warnings: absence of detected conflict is not consensus
minority/counterevidence must remain visible

explorers.label: Typed scientific relationship
explorers.denominator_basis: eligible relation instances / source-target entities / unique papers
required_warnings: co-occurrence is not a relation
paper relation is not taxonomy hierarchy, collaboration edge or L7 framework edge
reverse relation is not inferred automatically

explorers.label: Atlas research gap
explorers.denominator_basis: approved curated gap objects; support papers/PEUs separate
required_warnings: L6 cannot create official gaps
frequency is not a research gap
support-object count and support-paper count remain distinct

explorers.label: Atlas research opportunity
explorers.denominator_basis: approved curated opportunity objects; support papers/PEUs separate
required_warnings: L6 cannot create official opportunities
future-work frequency is not a research opportunity
support-object count and support-paper count remain distinct

default_warnings: principal record/assignment count must remain distinct from unique paper count
missing/not-reported/unresolved states must not be silently dropped

child_catalogues.note: availability/exposure follows Task 5.4 disposition and existing-owner rules

rules: only one child owner is aggregated at a time by default
Task 5.4 disposition and Task 5.5 promotion governance remain controlling

stop_boundary: Task 6.2 defines the complete single-dimension explorer contract only. Task 6.3 has not started.
